# `aitbc ipfs download`

Download content by CID and optionally write it to a file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ipfs download [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--cid` | text | — | no | The Cid. |
| `--output` | path | — | no | Write retrieved content to this path |
| `--wait` | flag | `false` | no | Wait for the CID to become available on the network |
| `--access-key` | text | — | no | Deprecated; use `aitbc market download` instead |
| `--access-secret` | text | — | no | Deprecated; use `aitbc market download` instead |
| `--rental-id` | text | — | no | Deprecated; use `aitbc market download` instead |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ipfs download
aitbc ipfs download --output json
```
